SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Treat offshore fishing as a separately confirmed boat day rather than an automatic inclusion in a flats package. Check the trolling tackle and sea-state contingency before adding heavy equipment to an inter-island baggage allowance.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

What is established—and what is not

The named place or operator program is supported by the source statement above. The relevant page text was inspected. The environment, access and gear categories are editorial planning scenarios to confirm locally, not guaranteed availability or unrestricted fishing access.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Kiribati

Visitors need a personal licence to fish a customary ground belonging to a community of which they are not members. Confirm the island's requirements before assuming that a lodge or boat booking includes permission.

  • As endorsed; normally no more than 1 yearCustomary fishing-ground licence
Official rules ↗

Permits for this trip

  • Kiritimati tourist fishing permit ↗ · $50 USD
    Every tourist who fishes within Kiritimati waters Obtain the permit from the Fisheries Secretary; arrange the local issue with the lodge before fishing.

Rules for this water

  • The tourist permit applies to Kiritimati's internal waters and territorial sea, including offshore fishing within that area.
  • The permit lasts one week and can be renewed.
  • Tourists may not use nets other than dip nets.
  • Bonefish capture must follow the permit conditions; otherwise return the fish immediately with minimal injury.

Full Kiribati licence guide ↗ · Checked November 2026.
